body: Just a stylistic nitpick. In the two cases above, you declare a numeric variable `line` and use `.ToString()` at the end. But here, you declare a string variable `line`.

According to documentation[^1], this is 0-based line numbering. Shouldn't it be 1-based in the POT files?

[^1]: https://learn.microsoft.com/fr-fr/dotnet/api/microsoft.codeanalysis.text.lineposition

If the number of arguments is not 4, line "0" will be added. This doesn't look right to me.

For `Tr()` and `TrN()`, the line number should be determined by the call, not by the optional argument (since these method calls can contain multiple translatable strings at once, and we want to specify only one starting line, not a line range). At least that's the logic in GDScript ([source](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/36b92128b1bce1f98687add98c84fd70ae9b20ca/modules/gdscript/editor/gdscript_translation_parser_plugin.cpp#L344-L400)):

`tr()`, `atr()`:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/36b92128b1bce1f98687add98c84fd70ae9b20ca/modules/gdscript/editor/gdscript_translation_parser_plugin.cpp#L355

`tr_n()`, `atr_n()`:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/36b92128b1bce1f98687add98c84fd70ae9b20ca/modules/gdscript/editor/gdscript_translation_parser_plugin.cpp#L375

But other methods like `set_text()`:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/36b92128b1bce1f98687add98c84fd70ae9b20ca/modules/gdscript/editor/gdscript_translation_parser_plugin.cpp#L379

Also note the comment:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/36b92128b1bce1f98687add98c84fd70ae9b20ca/modules/gdscript/editor/gdscript_translation_parser_plugin.cpp#L350
